    input wire reset,
    input wire [1:0] workload,

);

    input reset,
    input taken, // Branch taken input
    output reg prediction // Prediction output
);

    // State encoding: 00 (Strongly not taken), 01 (Weakly not taken), 10 (Weakly taken), 11 (Strongly taken)
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= 2'b00; // Initialize state to Strongly not taken
            prediction <= 1'b0; // Prediction output

            case (state)
                2'b00: begin
                    if (taken) begin
                        state <= 2'b01; // Move to Weakly not taken

                    prediction <= 1'b0; // Predict not taken

                2'b01: begin

    input clk,
    input rst,
    input [3:0] current_node,
    output reg [3:0] next_node
);

    parameter IDLE = 3'b000, LOAD = 3'b001, VISIT = 3'b010, DONE = 3'b011;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            state <= IDLE;
            next_node <= 4'b0000;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (current_node < 4) begin
                        state <= LOAD;
                    end

                LOAD: begin
                    next_node <= current_node; // Load current node
                    state <= VISIT;

                    case (current_node)

                        4'b0001: next_node <= 4'b0010; // Node 1 visits Node 2
                        4'b0010: next_node <= 4'b0011; // Node 2 visits Node 3
                        4'b0011: next_node <= 4'b0100; // Node 3 visits Node 4
                        4'b0100: next_node <= 4'bxxxx; // Node 4 has no next node
                        default: next_node <= 4'bxxxx; // Undefined state
                    endcase
                    state <= DONE;
                end
                DONE: begin
                    state <= IDLE; // Reset to IDLE for the next input

            endcase

    input clk,
    input rst,
    input signed [15:0] sensor1,
    input signed [15:0] sensor2,
    input signed [15:0] estimated_position,
    output reg signed [15:0] refined_position
);
    // Kalman filter parameters (for simplicity)
    parameter signed [15:0] Q = 16'h0001; // Process noise covariance
    parameter signed [15:0] R = 16'h0004; // Measurement noise covariance
    reg signed [15:0] P; // Estimation error covariance

    reg signed [15:0] z; // Measurement
    reg signed [15:0] x; // Updated estimate

        if (rst) begin
            refined_position <= 16'h0000;
            P <= 16'h0001; // Initial guess for P

            // Prediction step
            P <= P + Q;

            // Measurement update step
            z <= (sensor1 + sensor2) >> 1; // Average of sensors
            K <= P / (P + R); // Kalman gain
            x <= estimated_position + K * (z - estimated_position); // Update the estimate
            P <= (16'h0001 - K) * P; // Update the error covariance

            refined_position <= x; // Output the refined position
        end
    end
endmodule

description: Design an echo cancellation module that takes an input signal and an echo signal, processes them and outputs the cancelled signal. The echo cancellation is done using a simple subtractor where the output = input signal - echo signal.
code:
module echo_cancellation (  
    input clk,  
    input rst,  
    input [15:0] input_signal,  
    input [15:0] echo_signal,  
    output reg [15:0] cancelled_signal  
);  

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin  
        if (rst) begin  
            cancelled_signal <= 16'b0;  
        end else begin  
            cancelled_signal <= input_signal - echo_signal;  
        end  
    end  
endmodule

description: Create a 16-bit up counter with enable and reset functionality. The counter should increment on each clock cycle when the enable signal is high and reset to zero when the reset signal is asserted high.
code:
module counter_16bit (
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire enable,
    output reg [15:0] count
);

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            count <= 16'b0;
        end else if (enable) begin
            count <= count + 1;
        end
    end
endmodule
